Information Note to the Press (Press Release No. 131 /2026) 
TELECOM REGULATORY AUTHORITY OF INDIA 
www.trai.gov.in 
Bhopal, October 2026 
For Immediate Release 
  
TRAI Assesses Mobile Network Quality Across Bilaspur and Janjgir-Champa City including Limtara, 
Darrighat, Torwa, Sirgitti, Basiya, Silpahri, Tarbahar chowk, Telipar, Gol Bazar, Rajkishore Nagar, 
Narmada Nagar, Birkona and Lokhandi etc  in Bilaspur City &  NH49, Paraghat toll, Taraod, Nariyara, 
Mulmula, Vyasnagar, Bhainso, Banahil, Amartal, Janjgir, Madwa, Jarwe, Udayband, Ghatoli, and Seoni 
etc in Janjgir-Champa City. 
 The Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) has released findings of Independent Drive 
Test (IDT) conducted through its appointed agency across Bilaspur and Janjgir-Champa City under MP 
LSA, during the month of August 2026, for information of general telecom consumers. The purpose of 
this drive test is to assess and verify real time quality of mobile network services (both voice & data) 
provided by Telecom Service Providers (TSPs). The performance of TSPs for key Qualit y of Service 
(QoS) parameters, captured during IDT are published to inform Consumers and encourage TSPs to 
improve their services. These IDTs have been designed to capture on ground mobile network performance 
of all TSPs across diverse usages environment like cities, hotspots, public transport hubs, etc. ` 
2. These tests were conducted under the supervision of the TRAI Regional Office Bhopal. The 
observations presented in drive test reports represent the performance of the TSPs on the area/ route under 
test on the day/ time of conducting the drive test. 
3. The drive tests conducted across City drive – 346.7 KMs in Bilaspur and Janjgir -Champa 
districts including 29.7 Inter Operator Calling & 3.6 Km walk Test in Bilaspur City  from 17th August 
2026 to 20th August 2026 in MP LSA. 
4. Drive Test Route Map: The following map provides overview of drive test routes indicating 
City drive, Inter-operator calling, Hotspots and Walk tests, as per the legends shown on the map: - 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

2 
 
 
      5.  Key Parameters Assessed 
a) Coverage Gap: Percentage of samples, for which signal strength observed less than the 
minimum prescribed signal strength for respective technology (2G/ 3G/ 4G/ 5G). 
b) Voice Services: Call Setup Success Rate (CSSR), Drop Call Rate (DCR), Call Setup Time, 
Call Silence (Mute) Rate, Speech Quality (MOS). 
c) Call Silence (Mute) Instance: Number of call silence (Mute) instance occurred during the 
calls. 
d) Data Servies: Download/ Upload Throughput, Latency, Jitter, Packet Drop Rate 
 
6. The overall mobile network performance in Bilaspur and Janjgir -Champa City for the key 
parameters has been summarised below: - 
a) Coverage Gap - The signal strength observed during voice testing on the drive test route in 
auto-selection mode (5G/4G/3G/2G), measured as the number of samples having poor signal 
strength out of the total samples collected, w ere 523/ 36513 for Airtel, 1134/ 35925 for 
BSNL, 489/ 35197 for RJIL and 2019/ 36164 for VIL for Bilaspur City and 864/ 15028 for 
Airtel, 2846/ 14292 for BSNL, 676/ 13372 for RJIL and 2607/ 14570 for VIL for Janjgir-
Champa City. Details of the coverage gaps have been provided in the map Annexed. 
 
b) Dropped Calls - Dropped calls, measured as the number of dropped calls out of the number 
of successfully established calls, were 1/ 325 for Airtel, 7/ 319 for BSNL, 1/ 306 for RJIL 
and 2/ 325 for VIL for for Bilaspur City City and 0/ 134 for Airtel, 1/ 126 for BSNL, 0/ 104 
for RJIL and 3/ 164 for VIL for Janjgir-Champa City. Details of the dropped call locations 
have been provided in the map Annexed. 
 
c) Call Silence Instance  - Call silence instances, measured as the total number of silence 
instances observed for > 3 seconds out of the total calls established, were 6/ 319 for Airtel, 
20/ 313 for BSNL, 3/ 310 for RJIL and 14/ 313 for VIL for Bilaspur City and 4/ 128 for 
Airtel, 4/ 116 for BSNL, 5/ 115 for RJIL and 14/ 127 for VIL for Janjgir-Champa City. 
Details of the call silence instance locations have been provided in the map Annexed. 
 
d) Data Download and Upload Throughput: 
 
i) Data Download performance (Overall) : Average download speed was observed as 
128.61 Mbps for Airtel (5G), 12.33 Mbps for BSNL (4G), 177.88 Mbps for RJIL (5G) 
and 21.58 Mbps for VIL (4G) for Bilaspur City and 90.93 Mbps for Airtel (5G), 11.93 
Mbps for BSNL (4G), 112.13 Mbps for RJIL (5G) and 20.37 Mbps for VIL (4G) for 
Janjgir-Champa. Detail of Download throughput has been provided in the map Annexed.  
 
ii) Data Upload performance (Overall) : Average upload speed was observed as 24.02 
Mbps for Airtel (5G), 6.39 Mbps for BSNL (4G), 13.26 Mbps for RJIL (5G) and 14.66 
Mbps for VIL (4G) for Bilaspur City and 17.09 Mbps for Airtel (5G), 5.50 Mbps for 
BSNL (4G), 8.59 Mbps for RJIL (5G) and 10.91 Mbps for VIL (4G) for Janjgir-
Champa. Detail of Upload throughput has been provided in the map Annexed. 
 
Locations of Dropped Calls and Call Silence instances can be seen by clicking red dot on 
the map Annexed. 
 
7. Details of drive test route and area covered during the IDT is as under: - 
 
a) City – Bilaspur District - Limtara, Darrighat, Torwa, Sirgitti, Basiya, Silpahri, Tarbahar 
chowk, Telipar, Gol Bazar, Rajkishore Nagar, Narmada Nagar, Birkona and Lokhandi etc. 
Janjgir-Champa District - NH49, Paraghat toll, Taraod, Nariyara, Mulmula, Vyasnagar, 
Bhainso, Banahil, Amartal, Janjgir, Madwa, Jarwe, Udayband, Ghatoli, and Seoni etc.
